page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Printed page number 79 at top right. Heading in capitals with a Greek word, then one verse poem in five stanzas, set in a single column. Decorated initial S at the start of the poem.

main_text.l: alumnos, Et memori refer ore grates:
Qui, quanquam ab alto culmine Gallicæ

page.notes: Show-through of the reverse page (mirrored "VARIA POEMATA" and other mirrored lines at top and right) is not transcribed. No running head, catchword or signature is printed on this page. The initial S is a woodcut and is joined to "I quod" as "SI quod". Doubtful readings: the Greek word in the heading and "rectus" at the end of line 4 of the fourth stanza.
